import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
import "experimental"
import "array"

getOrDefault = (f, d) => if exists f then f else d

// Aggregate request counts per group
data_request = from(bucket: "default_agg_stats")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => (r._field == "prompt_tokens" or r._field == "completion_tokens" or r._field == "request_count" or r._field == "price" ) )
         |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.project_id)
    |> schema.fieldsAsCols()
    |> group(columns: ["project_id"])
    |> reduce(
        fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
          request_count: getOrDefault(f: r.request_count, d: 0) + accumulator.request_count,
          prompt_tokens: getOrDefault(f: r.prompt_tokens, d: 0) + accumulator.prompt_tokens,
          completion_tokens: getOrDefault(f: r.completion_tokens, d: 0) + accumulator.completion_tokens,
          price: getOrDefault(f: r.price, d: 0.0) + accumulator.price
        }),
        identity: {request_count: 0, prompt_tokens: 0, completion_tokens: 0, price:0.0}
    )
      |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        project_id: r.project_id,
      request_count: r.request_count,
      prompt_tokens: r.prompt_tokens,
      completion_tokens: r.completion_tokens,
      price: r.price,
         cost_per_request: if r.request_count > 0 then float(v: r.price) / float(v: r.request_count)*1000.0 else 0.0 ,// Safe division
         prompt_per_request: if r.request_count > 0 then float(v: r.prompt_tokens) / float(v: r.request_count) else 0.0 // Safe division
    }))
    data_request
    |> group()
    |> sort(columns: ["request_count"], desc: true)

import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
import "experimental"
import "array"

getOrDefault = (f, d) => if exists f then f else d

// Aggregate request counts per group
data_request = from(bucket: "default_agg_kpi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>  r._field == "request_count" and r.project_id !="" )
  |> schema.fieldsAsCols()
  |> group(columns: ["project_id"])
  |> sum(column:"request_count")
|>group()

  // Sort users by total_requests in descending order
sorted_users = data_request
  |> sort(columns: ["request_count"], desc: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with rowId: 1}))
  // Taking the cumulative sum gives sequential values 1,2,3,4 et...
  |> cumulativeSum(columns: ["rowId"])

// Calculate percentile thresholds
percentile_90_user = sorted_users |> quantile(column: "rowId", q: 0.9) |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
percentile_80_user = sorted_users |> quantile(column: "rowId", q: 0.8) |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
percentile_70_user = sorted_users |> quantile(column: "rowId", q: 0.7) |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
percentile_60_user = sorted_users |> quantile(column: "rowId", q: 0.6) |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
percentile_50_user = sorted_users |> quantile(column: "rowId", q: 0.5) |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
percentile_40_user = sorted_users |> quantile(column: "rowId", q: 0.4) |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
percentile_30_user = sorted_users |> quantile(column: "rowId", q: 0.3) |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
percentile_20_user = sorted_users |> quantile(column: "rowId", q: 0.2) |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
percentile_10_user = sorted_users |> quantile(column: "rowId", q: 0.1) |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
percentile_01_user = sorted_users |> quantile(column: "rowId", q: 0.01) |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)


// Map percentiles to each user based on request count thresholds
determinePercentiles = (sorted_users, topUsers) => 
  if topUsers == "No" then
    sorted_users
      |> map(fn: (r) => ({
          request_count: r.request_count,
          rowId: r.rowId,
          percentile_user: if r.rowId >= percentile_90_user.rowId then "0-10%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_80_user.rowId then "11-20%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_70_user.rowId then "21-30%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_60_user.rowId then "31-40%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_50_user.rowId then "41-50%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_40_user.rowId then "51-60%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_30_user.rowId then "61-70%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_20_user.rowId then "71-80%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_10_user.rowId then "81-90%"
                      else "Top 10%"
      }))
  else
    sorted_users
      |> map(fn: (r) => ({
          request_count: r.request_count,
          rowId: r.rowId,
          percentile_user: if r.rowId >= percentile_90_user.rowId then "0-10%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_80_user.rowId then "11-20%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_70_user.rowId then "21-30%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_60_user.rowId then "31-40%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_50_user.rowId then "41-50%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_40_user.rowId then "51-60%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_30_user.rowId then "61-70%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_20_user.rowId then "71-80%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_10_user.rowId then "81-90%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_01_user.rowId then "91-99%"
                      else "Top 1%"
      }))

// Define the bucket and call the function
topUsers = "${Show_Top1_percent}" // Replace with your actual bucket variable
percentiles = determinePercentiles(sorted_users: sorted_users, topUsers: topUsers)

// Count the number of users in each percentile
percentile_data =
percentiles
  |> group(columns: ["percentile_user"])
   |> sum(column: "request_count")
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with join_key: "cross_join"})) // Adding a dummy key for joining

|> group()
total_cost_data = percentiles

   |> sum(column: "request_count")
     |> map(fn: (r) => ({total_request_count: r.request_count, join_key: "cross_join"})) // Adding a dummy key for joining

   cross_joined_data = join(
  tables: {percentile: percentile_data, total: total_cost_data},
 on: ["join_key"]
)
 |> map(fn: (r) => ({

      percent_of_request: float(v: r.request_count) / float(v: r.total_request_count)*100.0,   
      percentile_user: r.percentile_user,
      sort: if r.percentile_user == "0-10%" then "0"
                  else if r.percentile_user == "11-20%" then "1"
                  else if r.percentile_user == "21-30%" then "2"
                  else if r.percentile_user == "31-40%" then "3"
                  else if r.percentile_user == "41-50%" then "4"
                  else if r.percentile_user == "51-60%" then "5"
                  else if r.percentile_user == "61-70%" then "6"
                  else if r.percentile_user == "71-80%" then "7"
                  else if r.percentile_user == "81-90%" then "8"
                  else if r.percentile_user == "91-99%" then "9"
                  else "99"
  }))
cross_joined_data
|>group()
|> sort(columns: ["sort"], desc: true)

  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with rowId: 1}))
  // Taking the cumulative sum gives sequential values 1,2,3,4 et...
  |> cumulativeSum(columns: ["rowId"])

// Calculate percentile thresholds
percentile_90_user = sorted_users |> quantile(column: "rowId", q: 0.9) |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
percentile_80_user = sorted_users |> quantile(column: "rowId", q: 0.8) |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
percentile_70_user = sorted_users |> quantile(column: "rowId", q: 0.7) |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
percentile_60_user = sorted_users |> quantile(column: "rowId", q: 0.6) |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
percentile_50_user = sorted_users |> quantile(column: "rowId", q: 0.5) |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
percentile_40_user = sorted_users |> quantile(column: "rowId", q: 0.4) |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

percentile_10_user = sorted_users |> quantile(column: "rowId", q: 0.1) |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
percentile_01_user = sorted_users |> quantile(column: "rowId", q: 0.01) |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)


// Map percentiles to each user based on request count thresholds
determinePercentiles = (sorted_users, topUsers) => 
  if topUsers == "No" then
    sorted_users
      |> map(fn: (r) => ({
          cost: r.cost,
          rowId: r.rowId,
          percentile_user: if r.rowId >= percentile_90_user.rowId then "0-10%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_80_user.rowId then "11-20%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_70_user.rowId then "21-30%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_60_user.rowId then "31-40%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_50_user.rowId then "41-50%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_40_user.rowId then "51-60%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_30_user.rowId then "61-70%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_20_user.rowId then "71-80%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_10_user.rowId then "81-90%"
                      else "Top 10%"
      }))
  else
    sorted_users
      |> map(fn: (r) => ({
          cost: r.cost,
          rowId: r.rowId,
          percentile_user: if r.rowId >= percentile_90_user.rowId then "0-10%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_80_user.rowId then "11-20%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_70_user.rowId then "21-30%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_60_user.rowId then "31-40%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_50_user.rowId then "41-50%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_40_user.rowId then "51-60%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_30_user.rowId then "61-70%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_20_user.rowId then "71-80%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_10_user.rowId then "81-90%"
                      else if r.rowId >= percentile_01_user.rowId then "91-99%"
                      else "Top 1%"
      }))

// Define the bucket and call the function
topUsers = "${Show_Top1_percent}" // Replace with your actual bucket variable
percentiles = determinePercentiles(sorted_users: sorted_users, topUsers: topUsers)


// Count the number of users in each percentile
percentile_data =
percentiles
  |> group(columns: ["percentile_user"])
   |> sum(column: "cost")
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with join_key: "cross_join"})) // Adding a dummy key for joining

|> group()
total_cost_data = percentiles

   |> sum(column: "cost")
     |> map(fn: (r) => ({total_cost: r.cost, join_key: "cross_join"})) // Adding a dummy key for joining

   cross_joined_data = join(
  tables: {percentile: percentile_data, total: total_cost_data},
 on: ["join_key"]
)
 |> map(fn: (r) => ({percent_of_request: float(v: r.cost) / float(v: r.total_cost)*100.0,
     
        cost:r.cost,
        Percentile_user: r.percentile_user,
        sort: if r.percentile_user == "0-10%" then "0"
                  else if r.percentile_user == "11-20%" then "1"
                  else if r.percentile_user == "21-30%" then "2"
                  else if r.percentile_user == "31-40%" then "3"
                  else if r.percentile_user == "41-50%" then "4"
                  else if r.percentile_user == "51-60%" then "5"
                  else if r.percentile_user == "61-70%" then "6"
                  else if r.percentile_user == "71-80%" then "7"
                  else if r.percentile_user == "81-90%" then "8"
                  else if r.percentile_user == "91-99%" then "9"
                  else "99"
  }))
cross_joined_data
|>group()
 |> rename(columns: {"percent_of_request": "Percent of Cost", "cost": "Cost($)"})
|> sort(columns: ["sort"], desc: true)
|> drop(columns: ["sort"])
